reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: License required for public auctioneers
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: prohibits exercising the trade or business of a public auctioneer selling goods, property, or real estate without a license.

headings.title: Auctioneer defined and exclusions
headings.reviewNote: Revised title to flag exclusions. Verified sub 2: defines 'auctioneer' for §§ 150.380, 343.010, and 343.070 to 343.105 (compensated sales for another), excluding court-jurisdiction/judicial-order sales, real-estate foreclosure sales, and owners selling their own property.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 343.010 (bid 18361), both subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 14912, A.L. 1978 H.B. 1170; prior revisions 1909-1929). Retained sub 1 title; revised sub 2 title from 'Auctioneer defined' to 'Auctioneer defined and exclusions' to reflect explicit carve-outs for court-ordered sales, real estate foreclosures, and owners selling their own property.

headings.title: License fee schedule
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1 and subdivisions (1)-(4): fees payable to the county clerk before delivery ($10 for 1 month, $20 for 3 months, $30 for 6 months, $50 for 12 months).

headings.title: Statewide validity of county license
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: an auctioneer license issued in any Missouri county is valid in every county during the period issued.

headings.title: Fees paid to county general revenue
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: all fees imposed by § 343.080 must be paid into the county general revenue fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 343.080 (bid 18367), all three subsections with subdivisions (1)-(4), and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 14919 through A.L. 1981 S.B. 105; prior revisions 1909-1929). All three draft titles accurately reflect the archived text; no title changes needed.
